subtitle: Lesson 10 · System Design for Data Engineers

eyebrow: The same idea, a different boundary
code:
Partitioning:  FactOrders split into folders, all inside
               ONE Delta table, on ONE storage system
Sharding:      customer data split across FOUR separate
               database servers, each knowing only its slice
caption: Sharding is overwhelmingly an OLTP scaling technique.

code:
Shard key: customer_id (hashed)
  Shard 1: hash(customer_id) % 4 == 0
  Shard 2: hash(customer_id) % 4 == 1
  Shard 3: hash(customer_id) % 4 == 2
  Shard 4: hash(customer_id) % 4 == 3
caption: A good shard key spreads both storage and traffic evenly.

code:
Bad:   Shard key = signup_date
       -- every new signup hits TODAY's shard
       -- older shards sit nearly idle
Good:  Shard key = hash(customer_id)
caption: One overloaded shard, three others doing nothing about it.

subtitle: Making sure retries never corrupt the data.
